# Margins

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

The active vertical scrolling region and horizontal text-output margins.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#text-margins).

## Bottom

`Margins.Bottom: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

The current 1-based margin edge, or zero when that margin is not active.

## HasHorizontal

`Margins.HasHorizontal: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether the corresponding terminal margin is active.

## HasVertical

`Margins.HasVertical: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether the corresponding terminal margin is active.

## Left

`Margins.Left: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

The current 1-based margin edge, or zero when that margin is not active.

## ResetAll

```PPL
Margins.ResetAll() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Restores both margin axes. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends DECSTBM reset `CSI r`, followed by DECRST 69 `CSI ? 69 l`.

## ResetHorizontal

```PPL
Margins.ResetHorizontal() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Restores the full terminal width. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends `CSI ? 69 l` (DECRST private mode 69), bytes `ESC [ ? 6 9 l`.

## ResetVertical

```PPL
Margins.ResetVertical() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Restores the full terminal height. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends DECSTBM reset `CSI r`, bytes `ESC [ r`.

## Right

`Margins.Right: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

The current 1-based margin edge, or zero when that margin is not active.

## SetHorizontal

```PPL
Margins.SetHorizontal(INTEGER left, INTEGER right) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets 1-based left and right columns; `left` must be at least 1 and less than `right`.
<br><br>**Terminal protocol:** first sends DECLRMM `CSI ? 69 h` (DECSET private mode 69), then DECSLRM `CSI left ; right s`. Requires a DEC-compatible terminal with left/right margin support; many basic ANSI terminals do not implement it.

## SetVertical

```PPL
Margins.SetVertical(INTEGER top, INTEGER bottom) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets 1-based top and bottom rows; `top` must be at least 1 and less than `bottom`.
<br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends DECSTBM `CSI top ; bottom r`, bytes `ESC [ top ; bottom r`. Requires a VT/ANSI terminal that implements DECSTBM; unsupported terminals may ignore it.

## Top

`Margins.Top: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

The current 1-based margin edge, or zero when that margin is not active.
